description: This bar chart illustrates the Recall and F1 Score performance of three different models: DIN-SQL (zero-shot), TA-SQL (zero-shot), and DIN-SQL (few-shot). The horizontal axis represents the evaluation metric, labeled “Recall” and “F1 Score”, in that order, and is categorical. The vertical axis represents the score, labeled “Score”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. Three groups of bars are presented, one for each model. For Recall, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar is light blue and extends to a value of approximately 63.58, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is dark blue and extends to a value of approximately 72.29, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is light green and extends to a value of approximately 75.34. For F1 Score, the DIN-SQL (zero-shot) bar is light blue and extends to a value of approximately 80.40, the TA-SQL (zero-shot) bar is dark blue and extends to a value of approximately 88.89, and the DIN-SQL (few-shot) bar is light green and extends to a value of approximately 92.31. The bars are arranged in pairs corresponding to each metric, and are not sorted in any apparent order. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
